"''Before the end of our wars, they turned it into a mining base. The sheer number of mining facilities here nearly destroyed our forests.|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]]|}} The '''Concordian mines''' were a series of [[Mining/Legends|mines]] constructed on [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore's]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]], [[Concordia/Legends|Concordia]]. Used by the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] to mine for [[Ore/Legends|ore]] deposits of the nearly indestructible [[Beskar/Legends|''beskar'']] [[Iron/Legends|iron]], the sheer scope of the operation and the vast number of mining facilities took a toll on Concordia's natural [[Tree/Legends|forests]], nearly destroying them. By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Concordia's mines were largely believed to be abandoned and inactive by the government of the [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorians]]. However, they continued to be used in secret by the radical Mandalorian splinter faction known as the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]], who transformed [[Death Watch hideout|one of the facilities]] as a base of operations and utilized the mine's industrial equipment in the creation of [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|armor]] and [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpacks]] for their Death Watch [[Troop/Legends|troops]]. During an investigation into the Death Watch that led him to the Concordian mines, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] discovered the facilities were still functioning and [[Fight on Concordia/Legends|engaged]] a number of Death Watch [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] both within the underground mines, and at their base on the surface. ==History== {{Quote|I'd like to see one of these mining facilities for myself.''"
"''You mean you want to determine if they're still operational.''"
"''I ''hope'' to determine they're ''not.|Obi-Wan Kenobi and Satine Kryze|}} [[File:ConcordianMines.png|thumb|left|275px|Obi-Wan Kenobi, surveying the Concordian mines]] Centuries prior to the [[Declaration of a New Order|rise]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]],''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: New Battlefronts: The Visual Guide]]'' the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] of [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] transformed the previously agricultural [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Concordia/Legends|Concordia]] into a [[Mining/Legends|mining]] base in search of [[Beskar/Legends|''beskar'']] [[Iron/Legends|iron]] [[Ore/Legends|ore]]—a nearly indestructible metal believed unique to Mandalore and its moon, so strong it was capable of withstanding blows from a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].''[[Legacy of the Force: Sacrifice]]'' Ugly mines scarred the surface of Concordia in such great numbers that the ''beskar'' mining operation threatened to destroy the native [[Tree/Legends|forests]] of Concordia. By the beginning of the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]-wide conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] known as the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the mines of Concordia were believed by the leadership of the [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorians]] to be abandoned and inactive. Without the large-scale strip-mining, Concordia's forests were allowed to flourish again, and by [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]'' had truly begun to make a comeback. In secret, however, the radical Mandalorian splinter group known as the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] had taken up residence in one of Concordia's mines, turning it into a covert [[Death Watch hideout|base of operations]]. There, the Death Watch utilized the abandoned industrial machinery within the mine in the creation of [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|armor]], [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpacks]], and weapons for their [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]]. [[File:ObiWan_strung_up.png|thumb|right|275px|Kenobi is held captive by industrial equipment in the mines of Concordia]] During his investigation into the Death Watch threat on Mandalore, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] traveled to Concordia with New Mandalorian leader, [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]], and set his sights on the supposedly inactive mines. While surveying the mines for evidence of activity, Kenobi found that they were indeed still functional; the Jedi Master was attacked by a pair of Death Watch [[Troop/Legends|troops]] within the mine, incapacitated, and captured. Before he could be [[Death/Legends|killed]], however, Kenobi was rescued by Duchess Kryze and the two fled the underground mine for the surface. There, they encountered further Death Watch forces at their base, and Kenobi [[Fight on Concordia/Legends|battled]] several Death Watch warriors and the group's leader, [[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]], before being forced to escape in the face of overwhelming enemy numbers. Even after their discovery at the [[Limb/Legends|hands]] of Master Kenobi, the Death Watch continued to operate from their base within the mines for a time,{{TCW|Duchess of Mandalore}} but were eventually driven from Concordia. Fleeing the [[Mandalore system/Legends|Mandalore system]],{{SWE|locations|zanbar|Zanbar}} the splinter group took temporary [[Carlac Death Watch camp/Legends|refuge]] on snowy [[Carlac/Legends|Carlac]],{{TCW|A Friend in Need}} before returning to [[Mandalore sector/Legends|Mandalorian space]] and establishing a [[Zanbar Death Watch camp|base]] on the [[Swamp/Legends|swampy]] world of [[Zanbar/Legends|Zanbar]]. ==Behind the scenes== The mines of Concordia first appeared in ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in the twelfth episode of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series' [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|second season]], entitled "[[The Mandalore Plot]]." They appeared again in the later fourteenth episode of that season, "[[Duchess of Mandalore]]." ==Appearances== *{{TCW|The Mandalore Plot}} {{1st}} *{{TCW|Duchess of Mandalore}} ==Sources== *''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: New Battlefronts: The Visual Guide]]'' ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} [[Category:Concordia locations]] [[Category:Mandalorian military bases]] [[Category:Mining areas]]
